instructions.step: Preheat oven to 375 F.
In a stand mixer, cream butter, sugars, eggs, and extract until light and fluffy.
Add soda, salt, and flour and mix until just combined.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Place 2-Tbsp scoops on cookie sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Allow to cool on cookie sheet for 5-10 minutes until set.
Enjoy with a glass of milk!
Saute onion, carrot, and celery in oil until onion is translucent.
Stir in thyme and sage.
Add chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in peas, noodles and chicken.
Simmer until noodles are tender.

title: White Bread
description: Great for sandwiches or as a side for soup.

instructions.step: In a large bowl, combine water, sugar, and yeast and proof until foamy.
Stir in salt and oil, then stir in flour one cup at a time.
Knead until smooth and elastic.
Rise in a well-oiled bowl until doubled, about 1 hour.
Punch dough down and knead for a few minutes.
Shape into two loaves and place in well-oiled bread pans.
Rise until dough is about 1" above the edge of the pan.
Bake at 350 F for about 30 minutes.
Place roast, water, broth, and soup mix into a 4-5 qt crockpot.
Cook on low 8-10 hours until meat is fork-tender.
About 2 hours before serving, add carrots and potatoes and allow to cook until tender.
Shred or slice and serve.
Warm cream cheese in microwave until liquid.
Stir in remaining ingredients except Kosher salt and tortillas.
Place 3 Tbsp mixture onto each tortilla and roll up tightly.
Spray tops of tortillas with cooking spray and sprinkle with Kosher salt.
Bake at 425 F for 15-20 minutes until golden brown and hot in the centers.

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
description: Delicious over vanilla ice cream or as a fruit dip.

instructions.step: Combine butter, evaporated milk, sugar, sea salt, in a large saucepan and bring to a hard boil for about 8 minutes.
Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly.
Stir in chocolate chips and vanilla until smooth.

title: Fruit Dip
description: Creamy dip for fruit or pretzels

instructions.step: Stir cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla paste together until well combines.
Serve with fruit of your choice to dip!
